integrity: The result is supported by a complete algebraic argument and independent finite sanity checks. Finite checks are not substituted for the infinite-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: Excludes same-letter pair counts, higher-order subsequence constraints, NFA state complexity, and nonuniform random words; equivalent unindexed claims remain a priority risk.
scientific_scope: Complete deterministic automata for simultaneously vanishing distinct-letter ordered scattered-pair counts modulo m, for all alphabet sizes q>=2 and moduli m>=2; prime-modulus asymptotic densities.
title: Exact minimal automata and residue-periodic densities for modular mixed-pair words
